turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so you have until then. Before you say anything else, tell me who decided to enter a zero before anyone called me.
I asked you a question, Hale. Who decided, and when?
I want to walk you through what I found in the version history.
You still haven't told me who entered that zero before calling me. Fine, I'll come back to it. Show me the version history, and turn the screen so I can read it myself.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Subject: Owen Kalinowski, English 30-1 essay
Hale, cc Principal,
Further to our meeting today, Tuesday, November 10, nothing was agreed.
You have not told me who entered Owen's zero on November 3, or why I was not contacted first as procedure 4.2 requires.
I want a copy of the version history you referred to, the name of whoever decided the zero, and confirmation that nothing is on Owen's record.
Until then I expect the zero withdrawn.
I need all of this in writing by Thursday, November 12, or I will ask the principal for a review under procedure 4.6.
Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, with nothing agreed.
Moved at: "I want to walk you through what I found in the version history."
Slipped at: none.
